    Find your city desk

    Know what the number means.

    Cash to arrive

    Add the first rent payment, temporary stay, travel, setup and chosen professional support. Then add the refundable deposit to see the cash committed at arrival.

    Expenses and deposits

    A deposit is cash you may get back, subject to the lease and deductions. Keeping it separate shows why cash needed and money spent are different numbers.

    Known and still to check

    Confirmed quotes and your estimates both count towards the entered amount. Unknown or invalid amounts do not. Until every line is checked, this is a partial budget.

    Your figures, your plan

    This worksheet has no average rents, deposit limits, exchange rates or income tests. It does not judge affordability or whether a landlord will accept you. Use quotes for your own situation.

    Amounts stay in memory in this browser tab. Switching cities keeps a separate worksheet for each city; reloading clears them. Use Print / save as PDF to keep a copy on your device. Updated 9 November 2026.

    A person on your side of the move.

    When you are ready, take the unanswered questions to your city desk. BOOM works for the tenant; the desk confirms the scope before you start.
